findings.title: The best-embed template has invalid ERB/Ruby syntax
findings.body: This tag ends with `end if`, leaving a postfix `if` with no condition. The generated template cannot compile, so requests that render an existing embed fail instead of displaying the discussion. Close the conditional with `end`.

findings.title: Imported content is rendered as unsanitized HTML
findings.body: This assigns imported content the `raw_html` cook method, and `Post#cook` returns that raw string without sanitizing it. RSS item content is externally supplied, so a feed entry containing script or event-handler markup is stored and can execute for users viewing the post or embed. Sanitize imported HTML before it is persisted or rendered.

findings.title: Remote article fetching permits SSRF through redirects
findings.body: The worker fetches the supplied URL with `open`, but the host check in `TopicRetriever` validates only the initial URL. `open-uri` follows redirects, so a URL on the configured host can redirect to a private or internal address; the fetched response is then imported into a public topic. Validate every redirect destination and reject private/internal addresses (and disallowed ports) before fetching.

findings.title: Standard RSS items without a `content` field abort feed polling
findings.body: The poller assumes every parsed item has `content` and calls `scrub` on it. Common RSS feeds provide their body in `description` instead, leaving `i.content` nil; that raises an exception and stops the poll before the remaining items are imported. Handle the RSS description field as a fallback and tolerate missing content.
